title: Data Connections: Reach SQL Server, Web APIs, Elasticsearch and Files | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Data Connectors bring data from other systems into your Orchard Core site, so reports and data pipelines can use it next to the site's own data. A connection is set up once per system and shared by every data set that reads from it.

In this video:
• Why connections, and the four kinds: SQL Server, HTTP API, Elasticsearch and media library files
• Adding a connection and checking it with Save and test
• A files connection, and a web API connection with an API key
• What a failed check tells you, and why secrets are never shown again
• Test, Add data set and Delete, and why a connection in use can't be deleted
• The Elasticsearch and SQL Server forms
